input_sources.text: Gateway GW-18 uses a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with default thermal settings. During this observation the SoC temperature rose to 82 degrees Celsius and the Arm clock decreased. The GPU clock was not measured. No maintenance or parts use was recorded.

observations.text: Gateway GW-18 uses a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with default thermal settings.
During observation, the SoC temperature rose to 82 degrees Celsius.
The Arm clock decreased during the high-temperature event.
The GPU clock was not measured.
Raspberry Pi thermal guidance indicates that in the 80–85 °C range, Arm cores are progressively throttled.
At 85 °C, both Arm cores and the GPU are throttled.

proposed_actions.text: Monitor thermal performance to ensure temperatures do not reach 85 °C, which would trigger GPU throttling in addition to Arm throttling.

uncertainties.text: The GPU clock frequency was not measured, so the specific impact on GPU performance at 82 °C is unverified.
No maintenance or parts use was recorded, so it is unclear if any prior interventions affected the current thermal behavior.
